_README: JS class-based name-collision fixture (mirror of java-di-collision). Two services define process(); CheckoutHandler constructs both via `new`, and run() calls this.orderService.process(), which must resolve to OrderService only. Authored from source.
_di_resolution_note: HIGH-3 (JS): this.orderService = new OrderService() gives the field orderService type OrderService, so process() resolves to OrderService.process only. di_resolution=1.0 with receiver-type resolution; was 0.0 (short-name fan-out). Module-level functional DI (require + call outside a class) remains out of scope.
